items.title: Why Does Water Spin Down The Drain? (Not What You Think) #Shorts
items.description:
Why does water spin down the drain? The idea that Earth's rotation sets the direction in a sink is a myth. The effect is far too weak, and leftover motion in the water decides the spin. New fizzy fact every day on Fruit Soda.
Stock footage: Pixabay
items.caption: Does your sink spin the way you thought? 🌍 Comment YES or NO if you believed the myth. Follow for a fact every day.

items.title: Why Doesn't Water Fall Out Of An Upside Down Glass? #Shorts
items.description:
Why doesn't water fall out of an upside down glass with a card on top? Air pressure pushes up on the card harder than the water pushes down. A simple physics DIY. New fizzy fact every day on Fruit Soda.
Stock footage: Pixabay
items.caption: Upside down glass, no spill 😮 Do it over a sink! Comment A or B: does air push up or down? Follow for a fact every day.

items.title: How To Make A Cartesian Diver With A Ketchup Packet #Shorts
items.description:
How to make a Cartesian diver with a ketchup packet and a plastic bottle: squeeze the bottle and the packet sinks, let go and it rises. It shows pressure and density. New fizzy fact every day on Fruit Soda.
Stock footage: Pixabay
items.caption: Squeeze it and it sinks, let go and it floats 🧪 Easy DIY physics in 30 seconds. Comment DONE if you try it. Follow for a fact every day.

items.title: Why Does Water Climb Up A Paper Towel? #Shorts
items.description:
Why does water climb up a paper towel? It is capillary action: water sticks to fibres and to itself in tiny gaps. A simple physics demo you can try at home. New fizzy fact every day on Fruit Soda.
Stock footage: Pixabay
items.caption: Water walking uphill with no pump 🤯 Did you know paper towels do this? Comment YES or NO. Follow for a fact every day.
